title: Jimmy Palmiotti
description: "Upon receiving this assignment, I went out and bought a Darth Vader model kit," admits Jimmy Palmiotti. I figured this was a good way to study Vader's outfit and an even better excuse to have a model of my favorite STAR WARS villain." Palmiotti's first professional inking work was for Malibu Comics' EX-MUTANTS during the series' original run; this led to his first full inking assignment on Marvel's THE NAM. Since then he's established himself as a fan favorite with his work on THE PUNISHER and other popular titles. Recent projects include JUDGE DREDD, X, XOMBIE, SOLAR and NINJAK. Also, Palmiotti is showcasing his talents as a penciler in Malibu's highly-promoted GENESIS
